caption: The drawing depicts a textile, possibly a woven blanket or coverlet, laid out on a plain background. The textile is primarily composed of two colors: a dark blue and an off-white. The left and upper sections feature a large central geometric floral motif with four symmetrical, petal-like shapes radiating from the center, surrounded by sharp, triangular accents. The right portion of the textile is divided into a grid pattern with repeated, smaller motifs: a row of baskets filled with blooming flowers, another row of eight-pointed stars, and additional geometric lines and shapes. Running along the bottom and right edges is a zigzag border in alternating blue and white. The textile is finished with a fringe of blue threads on the right and bottom edges. The entire image is set against a light beige background, and a signature appears in the bottom right corner.
title: Woven Coverlet
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
